Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits you, it stuns you and pulls Amumu in, so move with a minion or jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns enemies in an area, so keep your distance before Amumu closes in and avoid grouping with allies. Amumu W Despair deals continuous damage at close range, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight with him.
Amumu.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Amumu deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Amumu.fight: Engage after Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Against a high-health Amumu, hit him first with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite after his health is lower. Keep the fight short to avoid Amumu W Despair’s damage over time.
Amumu.laning: Elise looks for ganks and invades after clearing a few early camps, once she has learned Elise E Cocoon. Prioritize lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your allies, and throw Elise E Cocoon from a side angle where minions won’t block it.
Amumu.combo: Find an angle with no minion or jungle monster in the path of Elise E Cocoon, then hit Amumu. After confirming the hit, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, then transform with Elise R Spider Form. Follow with Elise Q Venomous Bite to close in and land basic attacks. Save Elise E Rappel so you can escape.
Amumu.escape: Engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is down. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so hit him with Elise E Cocoon and close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Don’t go deep if Elise E Rappel, your way out, is on cooldown.
Amumu.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through mid game, but watch for Amumu approaching and using Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy on her. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so convert your earlier lead into objectives and turrets to end the game early.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from your allies and keep your distance in open terrain. Stay behind in Human Form and use Elise E Cocoon to catch a key target, then close in with R Spider Form on a target whose health has decreased after your allies engage. Fight where there is a unit you can descend onto with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you’re hit by consecutive abilities, then explodes, so dodge his first ability. If you’re ablaze, Brand Q Sear can also stun you, so move out of its projectile path or hide behind a minion. When you see Brand R Pyroclasm, spread out from allies to avoid its bouncing damage.
Brand.build: Early on, first buy a Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.fight: Look to engage right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used. If Brand isn’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear won’t stun you, so catch him with Elise E Cocoon, deal damage with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then dive in with R Spider Form.
Brand.laning: Don’t stand near minions Brand has set ablaze. When the wave is grouped, step to the side to find an approach angle. To keep minions from taking Elise E Cocoon, circle behind or around the side of the lane before throwing it. After clearing a few early camps, prioritize lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your allies.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, hit Elise E Cocoon first in Human Form, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to his feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow by transforming with Elise R Spider Form, diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and finishing with basic attacks. Elise E Rappel is your way out, so carefully decide whether to use it before engaging.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so close the distance right after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used. If you’re ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear, then bind him with Elise E Cocoon and go in.
Brand.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in Human Form and look for an angle to catch Brand with Elise E Cocoon. Spread out from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing, and don’t stand beside an ablaze ally. Close in with R Spider Form to finish Brand after an ally engages first or Brand’s health has decreased.
Brand.phase: Elise is strongest from the moment she learns E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks. Convert that lead into objectives and turrets to end the game early. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so avoid forcing the initial engage.

Briar.build: Build armor first to counter Briar’s main damage. If her counterattack after engaging is threatening, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to cover the opening right after you cast Elise E Cocoon. If her healing makes the duel drag on, get Morellonomicon for grievous wounds after completing one core item.
Briar.fight: Interrupt Briar E Chilling Scream’s charge with Elise E Cocoon to prevent its healing and wall stun. Against a high-health Briar, use Elise Q Neurotoxin first, then finish her with Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health is lower. During Briar W Blood Frenzy, she targets the nearest enemy, so find an angle for Cocoon from behind your frontline.
Briar.combo: After confirming the hit, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to the target’s feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, then transform with Elise R Spider Form. Follow with Elise Q Venomous Bite to close in and land basic attacks, then use Elise W Skittering Frenzy while your spiderlings are attached.
Briar.escape: Don’t engage just because Briar Q Head Rush is down. Wait until Briar W Blood Frenzy and Briar R Certain Death are also down, limiting her ways to move, and Briar E Chilling Scream can’t be used for crowd control. Then close the distance with Elise Q Venomous Bite and bind her with Elise E Cocoon, but first make sure Elise E Rappel is available for your escape.
Briar.phase: Early on, watch out for both Briar’s high kill participation and her reckless engages. Start gaining a lead with ganks and counterattacks once you learn Elise E Cocoon. Elise is strong from then through mid game, so convert your lead into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so look for chances to catch targets with Cocoon instead of staying in prolonged fights.
Briar.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and the enemy has stepped forward. Keep vision around the lanes so you can counter Briar's ganks, and don't stay long in areas without vision. If you meet Briar in the jungle, weakening her to delay her next route can be worthwhile instead of chasing her too far.
Briar.teamfight: As Elise, stay behind in human form and use Elise E Cocoon to interrupt Briar while she is charging an ability or lock down a priority target. Keep your backline damage dealers from stepping forward so your frontline can stand in the path of Briar W Blood Frenzy's engage and take the hit from Briar R Certain Death's bloodstone first. Once your team lands area-of-effect crowd control or the enemy's health has dropped, go in with R Spider Form to finish them off. Fight where you can retreat with Elise E Rappel.
Briar.watch: Briar Q Head Rush dashes in, stuns, and reduces armor and magic resistance, so keep your distance to avoid it. When Briar starts charging E Chilling Scream, interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon, and avoid taking the hit with a wall behind you. If Briar R Certain Death hits you and marks you as prey, move toward your allies and fight back together instead of trying to escape alone.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and when you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly, even at low health.
Ekko.build: Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. If you are counterattacked by Ekko’s sudden engage, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and use it right after throwing Elise E Cocoon.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his mobility is unavailable, giving you a chance to stun him with Elise E Cocoon. Once Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, attack high-health Ekko with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite after his health has decreased.
Ekko.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. After learning Elise E Cocoon, first try to gank lanes pushed toward your allies. Find an angle from behind or beside the lane so minions don’t take Elise E Cocoon. If you can’t locate Ekko, don’t invade recklessly given your low magic resistance.
Ekko.combo: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, hit him with Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow by transforming with Elise R Spider Form and diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite alongside your summoned spiderlings, then use basic attacks. Transform only after confirming Cocoon hit.
Ekko.escape: Don’t rush to engage when only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, since he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Close the distance with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch him with Elise E Cocoon during the window when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Avoid engaging if Elise E Rappel is on cooldown, as it will be hard to get back out.
Ekko.phase: Elise is strong from early game, after learning Elise E Cocoon, through mid game, so convert gank leads into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so use your early lead to end the game early. The available information doesn’t establish Ekko’s strength at different stages of the game.
Ekko.teamfight: Stay behind in Human Form and find an angle for Elise E Cocoon, looking to stun Ekko right after he closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid the area. Close in with R Spider Form to finish after your allies land area crowd control or the target’s health has decreased. Fight where there is a nearby unit you can descend onto with Elise E Rappel.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Also get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to prepare for Diana’s sudden engage.
Diana.fight: Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. Against a high-health Diana, open with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite once her health is lower. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush can be used to engage again.
Diana.laning: Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes pushed toward your allies where the opponent is extended forward. Set up the angle from behind or beside the lane so minions don’t intercept Cocoon.
Diana.combo: When Diana E Lunar Rush is on cooldown and there is no mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, land Elise E Cocoon. Confirm the hit, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at her feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, leap in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and use basic attacks.
Diana.escape: If Diana uses Diana E Lunar Rush to engage before landing Diana Q Crescent Strike, she has no way to escape during that window. Stun her with Elise E Cocoon, then attack with Elise Q Neurotoxin and Elise Q Venomous Bite. Before using Elise E Rappel, check for a unit to descend onto so you can dodge Diana’s counterattack or retreat.
Diana.phase: Turn the lead from early ganks into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights later, so use Cocoon to catch a priority target instead of fighting up front for too long.
Diana.teamfight: Space out based on Diana’s engage angle and secure vision on the flanks so several allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon. When an ally engages first or an enemy priority target’s health has decreased, switch to Elise R Spider Form to finish them, and fight where there’s a unit for Elise E Rappel to descend onto.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so sidestep it. If it hits and marks you, Diana can follow up again with E Lunar Rush, so move away from your current position. Don't engage right after Diana activates W Pale Cascade; wait for the orbs and shield to disappear.

Evelynn.watch: If you see the mark from Evelynn W Allure, retreat before the charm triggers and alert your allies. Beware of the heavy damage from Evelynn R Last Caress when health is low, and hold targeted abilities when Evelynn casts R.
Evelynn.build: Evelynn deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, so even after building items, prioritize retreating before the mark matures.
Evelynn.fight: While the mark from Evelynn W Allure is maturing, don’t confront her; create distance. Catch Evelynn with Elise E Cocoon right after she engages, start the fight with human-form Q Neurotoxin, then finish with R Spider Form Q Venomous Bite once health has decreased. If Evelynn R Last Caress is available, don’t chase deep just because Evelynn E Whiplash is on cooldown.
Evelynn.laning: Look for ganks after clearing your first few camps, once Elise has learned Elise E Cocoon. Choose lanes pushed toward your allies where the opponent is extended forward, and set up an angle from the side or behind the lane so minions don’t intercept Cocoon.
Evelynn.combo: When Evelynn R Last Caress is on cooldown, land human-form Elise E Cocoon first. Confirm the hit, place human-form Elise W Volatile Spiderling at her feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, then transform with Elise R Spider Form. With the spiderlings attached, leap in with R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite and follow with basic attacks.
Evelynn.escape: Evelynn can escape by combining Evelynn E Whiplash and Evelynn R Last Caress, so don’t engage just because one is on cooldown. In particular, look for a window before Evelynn R Last Caress is available again: close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon. Before engaging, check that R Spider Form Elise E Rappel is available so you have a way to retreat.
Evelynn.phase: Build a lead from after learning Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, then turn it into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights later, so look for an angle to catch a target with Cocoon instead of fighting up front for too long.
Evelynn.teamfight: In an area covered by allied vision, watch for Evelynn engaging on your backline damage dealers. Hold human-form Elise E Cocoon to catch her when she comes in. When an ally engages or the target’s health has decreased, close in with R Spider Form to finish them. Fight where R Spider Form Elise E Rappel has a unit to descend onto, keeping a way to retreat.

Fiddlesticks.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fiddlesticks deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Fiddlesticks.fight: After landing Elise E Cocoon, damage a high-health opponent with Elise Q Neurotoxin, which is strong against them. After transforming, finish Fiddlesticks with Elise Q Venomous Bite once his health has decreased. Time Elise E Cocoon so you can interrupt Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest when its channel starts.
Fiddlesticks.laning: Early on, clear the jungle in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, start ganking lanes pushed toward your allies. Set up from the side so Cocoon isn’t blocked by minions or jungle monsters. Keep vision in the bushes behind lanes to guard against Fiddlesticks ambushes, and invade only after checking the enemy jungler’s location.
Fiddlesticks.escape: Once Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap’s silence are on cooldown, there’s less risk of being interrupted when you close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Don’t go deep if Elise E Rappel isn’t ready to help you escape.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Elise is strong from after learning Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so build a lead with early ganks and invades. She contributes less to teamfights later, so turn your early lead into objectives and turrets.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Place Control Wards in the bushes and entrances around objectives, and don’t group up when entering narrow passages where you have no vision. As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon to interrupt Fiddlesticks’ channel or catch a priority target. When an ally engages first or a target’s health has decreased, close in with R Spider Form to finish them, and fight where Elise E Rappel can help you retreat.
Fiddlesticks.combo: In human form, land Elise E Cocoon first, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling under the caught Fiddlesticks, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and attack with basic attacks. If Cocoon misses, watch for Fiddlesticks' fear and silence before transforming and diving straight in.
Fiddlesticks.watch: Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm enters after channeling, so interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon as soon as you see the cast. If you can’t interrupt it, move out of range and wait out its duration. Fiddlesticks’s fear applies when he hits you with an ability from out of sight, so watch bushes and Scarecrow Effigies standing still. If you let Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest channel to completion, it heals more and its next use comes sooner.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, leave its radius before it explodes. If Gragas E Body Slam also hits you near the barrel, you’ll take a burst of damage, so don’t linger within that range. When Gragas has Gragas R Explosive Cask available, don’t stand with an enemy turret or the enemy team behind you.
Gragas.build: Gragas deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Gragas.fight: When Gragas starts drinking with Gragas W Drunken Rage, he takes reduced damage, so briefly delay your burst. Immediately after Gragas E Body Slam is used, open with Elise Q Neurotoxin and land Elise E Cocoon to block his escape. Finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after health has decreased.
Gragas.laning: Clear the jungle early in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, start ganking lanes pushed toward your allies. Set up from the side or behind the lane so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. Leave the area where Gragas Q Barrel Roll is placed immediately, and chase a retreating Gragas only when you can secure the kill.
Gragas.combo: Wait for Gragas E Body Slam to go on cooldown and the damage reduction from Gragas W Drunken Rage to end, then cast Elise E Cocoon. If it hits, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, then transform with Elise R Spider Form. Follow with Elise Q Venomous Bite and basic attacks.
Gragas.escape: The moment after you make Gragas use Gragas E Body Slam is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite and land Elise E Cocoon to make it hard for Gragas to escape. If Elise E Rappel is on cooldown, you have no escape, so avoid chasing deep.
Gragas.phase: Elise is strong from after learning Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so turn the lead from early ganks into objectives and turrets. Gragas also has strong burst and formation disruption in the early and mid game, so avoid getting hit while grouped or letting your formation scatter during objective fights. Elise contributes less to teamfights later, but Gragas’s sustained damage is also weak, so build on your early advantage and aim to end the game early.
Gragas.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in human form and look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon. Make sure your backline doesn’t stand alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. If your allies land area crowd control first or an enemy priority target’s health has decreased, transform with Elise R Spider Form to finish them. If Gragas E Body Slam hits you, leave the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll before trying to fight back.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he has run, so break vision or move toward your allies when he starts running. Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows can fear multiple enemies, so don’t group up with your allies. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, he heals from damage taken nearby, so don’t stay in an extended fight with him.
Hecarim.build: Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Hecarim.fight: When Hecarim approaches, stop him with Elise E Cocoon first and deal a quick burst of damage. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin when plenty of health remains, and Elise Q Venomous Bite after health has decreased.
Hecarim.combo: After hitting Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling under the target and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Then transform with Elise R Spider Form, leap in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and land basic attacks. Don’t transform before hitting Cocoon, and save Elise E Rappel so you can use it to disengage.
Hecarim.escape: When only Hecarim E Devastating Charge is on cooldown, he can still escape with Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows, so don’t chase recklessly. In particular, before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows comes back up, look for a chance to close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and stop him with Elise E Cocoon.
Hecarim.phase: Turn the advantages Elise gains from the early game through mid game into objectives and turrets, and snowball the game so it doesn’t drag on until her teamfight contribution falls off in the late game.
Hecarim.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and the enemy has stepped forward.
Hecarim.teamfight: Before a fight, stay back in human form and look for an angle to hit Elise E Cocoon. Spread out so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows doesn’t catch multiple allies. When an ally has engaged first or an enemy priority target is low, go in with R Spider Form to finish them off. Fight where there is a unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Ivern.watch: If you’re rooted by Ivern Q Rootcaller, Ivern’s allies can dash in, so avoid its angle by keeping minions or terrain between you and Ivern before he casts it. Don’t dive straight onto a target affected by Ivern E Triggerseed; engage after the shield bursts. If Daisy is in front, she can take Elise E Cocoon for the intended target, so change your angle. If Daisy starts attacking you, reposition to interrupt her consecutive attacks.
Ivern.build: Build Null-Magic Mantle early to hold out, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Ivern deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor, and watch for allies to follow up on Ivern Q Rootcaller or Daisy’s crowd control.
Ivern.fight: Close the gap right after Ivern Q Rootcaller is used and catch him with Elise E Cocoon. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first on an enemy with plenty of health, then finish them with Elise Q Venomous Bite after their health has decreased. If Ivern E Triggerseed is already on the target, delay your engage until the shield bursts.
Ivern.combo: After Ivern Q Rootcaller is used and Ivern E Triggerseed bursts, hit Elise E Cocoon from an angle not blocked by minions or Daisy. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling under the target, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Leap in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and finish with basic attacks.
Ivern.escape: The moment after you bait out Ivern Q Rootcaller is your window to engage. Close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite and catch him with Elise E Cocoon. Don’t go deep if Elise E Rappel is on cooldown.
Ivern.phase: Elise is strong from after learning Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades that target Ivern’s harvesting route. Convert that advantage into objectives and turrets. Elise’s teamfight contribution falls off in the late game, so use your lead to end the game instead of letting it drag on.
Ivern.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in human form and avoid Daisy while using Elise E Cocoon to pick off a key enemy target. Fight near an enemy unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel so you can retreat.
Ivern.laning: Place vision in Ivern’s jungle early to track camps where he has planted seeds and his harvesting route, then look for a chance to catch him alone. After learning Elise E Cocoon, gank lanes where the opponent has pushed toward your allies, positioning behind or to the side so minions don’t block Cocoon. Don’t casually walk past newly created areas of Ivern W Brushmaker.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so don’t fight with your back to a wall or in a narrow jungle passage. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area by the shortest route, then re-engage. Graves E Quickdraw grants movement, armor, and magic resistance and builds stacks, so the longer you fight him, the worse it gets.
Graves.build: Graves deals primarily physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps earlier and build armor first. Keep in mind that armor doesn’t reduce the magic damage from Graves W Smoke Screen.
Graves.fight: In open terrain, you can block Graves’s basic attacks by keeping minions or an ally between you and him. However, Elise E Cocoon also hits the first unit it reaches, so take a side angle with no minions in the way when you cast it. Counterattack while Graves reloads after firing two shots. Start with Elise Q Neurotoxin and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after health has decreased.
Graves.combo: From an angle with no minions in the way, hit Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling under the enemy, and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Then transform with Elise R Spider Form, close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and land basic attacks. If your spiderlings are on the target, use Elise W Skittering Frenzy to increase your attack speed.
Graves.escape: When only Graves E Quickdraw is on cooldown, he can still escape with Graves R Collateral Damage, so look for an opening after both mobility tools are used or before Graves R Collateral Damage comes back up. Then close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite, hit Elise E Cocoon, and deny him a chance to escape. If you’re caught in Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area before engaging.
Graves.phase: Elise is strong from after learning Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so slow Graves’s growth with early ganks and pressure. Graves gets stronger as he builds stacks of Graves E Quickdraw, making him harder to fight as time goes on. Convert your early lead into objectives and turrets to end the game early.
Graves.laning: After clearing a few camps, Elise pressures with ganks and invades from the moment she learns Elise E Cocoon. Prioritize lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and the enemy has stepped forward, giving Graves less time to build stacks on Graves E Quickdraw. Check the enemy jungler's location before invading.
Graves.teamfight: As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle to hit Elise E Cocoon and catch a priority target. When an ally has engaged first or the target is low, switch to Elise R Spider Form and finish them with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Avoid walls where Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately, and fight where there is a unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel when retreating.

JarvanIV.laning: Once you’ve learned Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your allies where the enemy has stepped forward.
JarvanIV.combo: Take a side angle so minions won’t block Elise E Cocoon. After confirming the hit, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling under the enemy and use Elise Q Neurotoxin.

Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and, when reactivated, deals area damage based on maximum health and stuns nearby enemies.
Jax.fight: Trade briefly after Jax E Counter Strike has been spent, and don’t stay in the fight long enough for Jax P Relentless Assault to build up attack speed. Right after Jax uses Q Leap Strike, catch him with Elise E Cocoon, then close the gap and deal damage with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, hit Elise E Cocoon, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to his feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Next, transform with Elise R Spider Form and close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, then basic attack while Jax E Counter Strike has not been activated again.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap and catch him with Elise E Cocoon. Engage if Jax E Counter Strike is also down. Save Elise E Rappel to dodge Jax’s engage and stun, or to escape after the fight.
Jax.phase: Elise is strong from learning Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and convert it into objectives and towers. Her teamfight impact falls off later, so focus on catching priority targets with Cocoon.
Jax.teamfight: When Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike and jumps in, don’t group nearby; keep your distance until the area stun ends. As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle with Elise E Cocoon. After your team engages, finish off targets whose health has decreased with R Spider Form. If Jax is pushing turrets in a side lane, pressure an objective elsewhere instead of forcing a one-on-one.
Jax.laning: After clearing a few camps early, Elise looks for ganks from the moment she learns Elise E Cocoon. Choose a lane where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and Jax has stepped forward, positioning to the side or behind the lane so minions don't block Cocoon.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so dodge its marked area. If you can’t, overlap with an ally or minion to avoid taking an isolated hit. Passing through Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces your magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall and spend less time in range of Karthus E Defile. Right after killing Karthus, move away immediately to avoid attacks near his body during Karthus P Death Defied. After a fight, keep enough health to survive Karthus R Requiem, which deals damage globally.
Karthus.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Karthus deals mostly magic damage and Elise has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no skill to create distance, so find an angle for Elise E Cocoon, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin on him while he has high health. After landing your human-form abilities, transform with Elise R Spider Form and send in your spiderlings. After Karthus’s health has decreased, close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite to finish him. If Karthus W Wall of Pain is placed, don’t cross it to engage.
Karthus.laning: For early jungle clears, use human-form abilities to build up your spiderlings, then clear in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes where Karthus is exposed and pushed toward your side.
Karthus.combo: Find an angle from the side and land Elise E Cocoon first so a minion or jungle monster doesn’t take it for Karthus. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Karthus’s feet, hit Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Dive on Karthus after his health has decreased with Elise Q Venomous Bite and follow with basic attacks. If you kill him, immediately leave the area around his body left by Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.escape: Dodge the marked area of Karthus Q Lay Waste and approach from outside Karthus W Wall of Pain. Don’t go deep if Elise E Rappel isn’t available for your escape.
Karthus.phase: Karthus clears quickly, so he can catch up if you miss early opportunities. Elise’s teamfight impact falls off later, so convert your early lead into objectives and towers.
Karthus.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in human form and catch a priority target with Elise E Cocoon. After your team engages, close in on enemies whose health has decreased with R Spider Form. Even after killing Karthus, his attacks continue during Karthus P Death Defied, so reposition immediately. Clear the frontline before entering range of Karthus E Defile, and fight near an enemy unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the line hitbox of Kayn W Blade’s Reach to avoid taking damage from a distance and getting caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Kayn Q Reaping Slash deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about prolonged fights. If Kayn enters a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, watch for the warning indicator along the wall’s edge and retreat toward your tower.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, W Blade’s Reach, and R Umbral Trespass. If you need to withstand a quick engage and counterattack, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier so you can survive just after throwing Elise E Cocoon. If Kayn transforms into Rhaast and keeps healing, consider fitting Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Kayn.fight: If you hit Kayn with Elise E Cocoon while he is in a wall using Kayn E Shadow Step, it immediately ends that ability. Use human-form Elise Q Neurotoxin first while Kayn has high health, then finish him with R Spider Form Q Venomous Bite after his health has decreased.
Kayn.laning: After clearing a few camps early, shift toward ganks and invades. Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes where the enemy is exposed and pushed toward your side. Invade after checking Kayn’s location, and avoid giving up an early kill that would accelerate his transformation.
Kayn.combo: After landing human-form Elise E Cocoon, place W Volatile Spiderling at Kayn’s feet and use Q Neurotoxin. Then transform with R Spider Form, close in with Q Venomous Bite, and follow with basic attacks. Transform after landing a human-form ability so you also summon spiderlings.
Kayn.escape: If only Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down, he can still escape with his other mobility, so don’t engage hastily. Look for a window before Kayn R Umbral Trespass comes back. After dodging Kayn W Blade’s Reach, close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite and catch him with E Cocoon.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak early before transforming, while Elise is strong from learning E Cocoon through the mid game. Build an advantage with ganks and objectives during this window and delay Kayn’s transformation. Elise’s teamfight impact falls off later, so turn your lead into towers and objectives and look to end the game early.
Kayn.teamfight: As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle to land E Cocoon. After your team engages, finish off targets whose health has decreased with R Spider Form. An ally caught by Kayn R Umbral Trespass can’t be helped while Kayn is inside them, so prepare Cocoon near the target and catch Kayn as he emerges. Fight near an enemy unit you can land on with Elise R Spider Form E Rappel to retreat.

Khazix.watch: Kha’Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals much more damage when you’re isolated, so stay near allies. If Kha’Zix uses E Leap to engage, save Elise E Cocoon and counterattack after he lands. When Kha’Zix disappears with R Void Assault, don’t chase his position; stay with your allies and look for Cocoon when he reappears.
Khazix.build: Prioritize armor because Kha’Zix’s main ability damage is physical. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to prepare for his sudden engage with Kha’Zix E Leap. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Khazix.fight: Fight near allies or minions to reduce the isolated damage from Kha’Zix Q Taste Their Fear. Once Kha’Zix E Leap is down, catch him with Elise E Cocoon. Hit Elise Q Neurotoxin while health is high, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after health has decreased.
Khazix.laning: After clearing a few camps early, start ganking lanes pushed toward your side once you learn Elise E Cocoon. Find a side angle so minions don’t overlap Cocoon’s path. Spend less time moving alone to avoid Kha’Zix’s isolated attacks, and secure vision in the river and jungle entrance bushes.
Khazix.combo: After Kha’Zix E Leap is down, hit Elise E Cocoon. Then send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to the enemy’s feet, hit Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and follow with basic attacks.
Khazix.escape: Right after Kha’Zix uses E Leap to engage is your window to go in, so use Elise E Cocoon then. If Kha’Zix disappears with R Void Assault, wait near your allies and look for Cocoon when he reappears. Save Elise E Rappel to dodge a counterattack or escape.
Khazix.phase: From learning Elise E Cocoon through the mid game is a strong window for Elise to build a lead, and Kha’Zix can also be pressured before his first evolution. From the mid game, when Kha’Zix has two or more evolutions, stop acting alone. Elise’s teamfight impact falls off later, so snowball your early lead into objectives and towers.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with your allies in a narrow area with vision to prevent the isolated damage from Kha’Zix Q Taste Their Fear. As Elise, stay behind in human form and look for an angle with Elise E Cocoon. After your team engages or the enemy’s health has decreased, close in with R Spider Form to finish them. While Kha’Zix is hidden by R Void Assault, stay grouped and look for Cocoon when he reappears.

LeeSin.watch: If Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave hits, watch out for Lee Sin Q Resonating Strike, which deals more damage based on your missing health. If you’re below half health, stay near your turret or team. Also watch for Lee Sin W Safeguard ward jumps from walls without vision. To prepare for Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, don’t give Lee Sin room to get behind you, and keep some distance from your allies.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass early to counter Lee Sin’s sudden engage and avoid the counterattack right after you throw Elise E Cocoon.
LeeSin.laning: When ganking, approach from behind or the side so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. If you need to dodge Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave, put minions or jungle monsters between you and Lee Sin.
LeeSin.combo: From an angle where minions won’t block Elise E Cocoon, land Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Lee Sin’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and attack with basic attacks. Transform after hitting with a human-form ability so your spiderlings join you.
LeeSin.escape: Engage before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up. If Lee Sin has just also used Lee Sin W Safeguard to engage, close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite, catch him with Elise E Cocoon, and focus your damage. Check that Elise E Rappel is available for your retreat.
LeeSin.phase: From when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, Elise can gain an advantage with ganks and convert it into objectives and turrets. Her teamfight contribution falls off late, as does Lee Sin’s power, so use your early and mid-game lead to end the game early.
LeeSin.teamfight: Look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon from behind in human form. After your team engages, finish targets whose health has dropped with R Spider Form. To prepare for Lee Sin R Dragon’s Rage, keep your back to a wall or your frontline, but leave enough space to avoid colliding with an ally who gets kicked. Fight near a unit you can descend onto with Elise E Rappel to retreat.
LeeSin.fight: If you run into Lee Sin in the early jungle, don't take the duel. Look for an opening after Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave misses or before he can use Q again, while accounting for Lee Sin W Safeguard if it's still available. Start with Elise Q Neurotoxin against Lee Sin while he has high health, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite once his health is low.

Kindred.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kindred Q Dance of Arrows and Kindred E Mounting Dread. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Kindred.fight: Look for an opening before Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy comes back up. If Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is also down, land Elise E Cocoon and engage. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first against Kindred while they have plenty of health, then finish them with Elise Q Venomous Bite after their health has decreased.
Kindred.laning: After clearing a few early camps and learning Elise E Cocoon, start ganking and pressuring the enemy jungle. Take camps marked by P Mark of the Kindred first, or ward nearby to delay Kindred from collecting the mark. When ganking, choose a lane where the enemy is pushed toward your allies, and throw Elise E Cocoon from an angle where minions won’t block it.
Kindred.combo: Wait until Kindred’s mobility ability is down, confirm Elise E Cocoon hits, then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at their feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, pounce with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and use basic attacks. If your spiderlings are on the target, use Elise W Skittering Frenzy to attack together with them.
Kindred.escape: Use the window while Kindred W Wolf’s Frenzy is down to engage, but if Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is still available, first find an angle to land Elise E Cocoon. Don’t keep taking hits while Kindred E Mounting Dread is applied; create distance or break vision. If Elise E Rappel is down, you have fewer ways to escape, so don’t dive in recklessly.
Kindred.phase: Elise can pressure with ganks and invades from the early game through mid game. Delay P Mark of the Kindred and convert your lead into objectives and turrets. Late game, Elise’s teamfight contribution falls off while Kindred’s damage and range grow with more marks, so aim to end the game early.
Kindred.teamfight: Look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon from behind in human form. After your team engages, close in on Kindred after their health has decreased with R Spider Form. When Kindred R Lamb’s Respite is active, enter the zone and use its protection and healing at the end alongside your team. Fight near an enemy unit you can descend onto with Elise E Rappel to retreat.
Kindred.watch: Kindred E Mounting Dread deals heavy damage based on your missing health if you're hit repeatedly after it's applied, so when your health is low, create distance or break vision. Inside the Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy zone, Kindred can frequently use Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to slip away, so don't stay and fight inside the zone for long.

Lillia.watch: Being hit by Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed applies Dream Dust, making you a target for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby’s sleep. Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge in narrow passages, so avoid entering when you don’t know where Lillia is. When you see the cast animation for Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, move to the side to avoid the center hit.
Lillia.build: Lillia deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build Null-Magic Mantle first to survive. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit in Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Lillia.laning: In the jungle, hit with human-form abilities to build up your spiderlings, then switch to Elise R Spider Form to clear camps. After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes pulled toward your allies where the enemy has stepped forward. If you don’t know where Lillia is, don’t pass through river paths or narrow jungle entrances where her seeds are hard to dodge.
Lillia.combo: After Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is down, land Elise E Cocoon from an angle where minions or monsters won’t block it. Once it hits, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to the target’s feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, pounce with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and use basic attacks.
Lillia.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so build an early lead with ganks. If you keep hitting Lillia with abilities and give her movement speed stacks, she becomes hard to chase, so dodge her abilities while looking for chances to fight. Elise’s teamfight contribution falls off late, so convert your earlier lead into objectives and turrets.
Lillia.teamfight: Look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon from behind in human form, and save it to catch Lillia if she comes in from the side. Fight near an enemy unit you can descend onto with Elise E Rappel to retreat.
Lillia.escape: Right after you make Lillia use Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your chance to engage. If you've also dodged Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed, close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon before she can stack movement speed. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby makes you drowsy, move to safety before you fall asleep.
Lillia.fight: Lillia's movement speed stacks with each ability hit, so dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed before fighting. Catch her with Elise E Cocoon right after she uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, and start the attack with Elise Q Neurotoxin, which is strong while her health is high. When her health is low, switch with Elise R Spider Form and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi can’t be targeted while using Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so throw Elise E Cocoon right after he lands. When Master Yi R Highlander is active, slows don’t work on him, and his basic attacks deal additional true damage while Master Yi E Wuju Style is active, so don’t fight him for long.
MasterYi.build: Master Yi E Wuju Style’s true damage can’t be reduced by resistances, so build health too. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
MasterYi.fight: Make Master Yi use Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, then catch him with Elise E Cocoon as he lands and start the fight with Elise Q Neurotoxin. After health has dropped, switch to Elise R Spider Form and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite. If Master Yi activates Master Yi W Meditate, interrupt the channel with the Elise E Cocoon you saved.
MasterYi.laning: Master Yi is weak in the early jungle and at ganking, so locate him and then invade or take early objectives to slow his growth.
MasterYi.combo: Land Elise E Cocoon just after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, pounce with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and use basic attacks. If your spiderlings are on him, use Elise W Skittering Frenzy to increase their attack speed too.
MasterYi.escape: The moment after Master Yi uses Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is your chance to engage. Land Elise E Cocoon on him as he lands, then close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin and Elise Q Venomous Bite. Don’t dive deep if Elise E Rappel isn’t ready for your escape.
MasterYi.phase: From the early game through mid game, Elise can build a lead with ganks and invades using Elise E Cocoon, and Master Yi is weak in the early jungle. Convert your lead into objectives and turrets to accelerate the game. The longer the game goes, the stronger Master Yi becomes and the less Elise contributes to teamfights.
MasterYi.teamfight: Set up Elise E Cocoon from behind in human form, and land it right after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike lands or the moment he activates Master Yi W Meditate. Lock down his initial engage with your team so he can’t get a takedown. Close in with R Spider Form to finish him when your team goes in first or after Master Yi’s health has dropped.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss deals more damage the farther away she is, so be especially careful to dodge it when she’s at a distance, and keep minions or allied frontline champions between you. Watch for Nidalee W Bushwhack on jungle entrances and in the river. If you’re hit by a spear or trap, save Elise E Cocoon or E Rappel for when Nidalee W Pounce closes the gap.
Nidalee.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Nidalee’s main damage is magic and Elise has low magic resistance, build magic resistance first.
Nidalee.fight: Fight after dodging Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack. If you bait out Nidalee W Pounce, close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon. When starting a fight, use Elise Q Neurotoxin on Nidalee while she has plenty of health, then finish her with Elise Q Venomous Bite after she’s taken damage.
Nidalee.combo: In Human Form, hit Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Nidalee’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with Elise R Spider Form, leap in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and use basic attacks. If Nidalee engages first with Nidalee W Pounce, respond to her engage with Elise E Cocoon or E Rappel.
Nidalee.escape: Nidalee has no crowd control, so the moment after she uses Nidalee W Pounce is an opportunity to engage. Close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon. Elise E Rappel is also needed to disengage, so don’t force an engage while it’s on cooldown.
Nidalee.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades. Convert that advantage into objectives and towers to end the game early. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so catch targets with Cocoon instead of trying to hold the frontline.
Nidalee.teamfight: Stay behind in Human Form, dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and watch where Nidalee steps out to throw her spear. If you get an opening, catch her with Elise E Cocoon. After your allies engage, switch to R Spider Form and finish off a target whose health has dropped. Fight where there’s an enemy unit to land on so you can retreat with Elise E Rappel.
Nidalee.laning: Clear camps in Elise R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. Once you've learned Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and Nidalee is present. Before entering jungle paths or the river, check for Nidalee W Bushwhack with a Control Ward or an area-of-effect ability. Invade only after confirming the enemy jungler's position.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is a targeted dash, so look for an angle from outside its range. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so don’t waste your abilities on it; check which way the real Wukong went.
MonkeyKing.build: Wukong’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, and Wukong R Cyclone deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
MonkeyKing.fight: Wukong gains armor and healing the longer a fight goes on, so deal damage briefly and back off. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used, check his remaining mobility ability, then lock down the real Wukong with Elise E Cocoon and engage. Wukong’s magic resistance is relatively low, so trade aggressively with Elise’s magic damage in early fights.
MonkeyKing.laning: Once you learn Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes pulled toward your allies where the enemy has stepped forward. Find an angle from the side or behind the lane so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon.
MonkeyKing.combo: Identify the real Wukong instead of the clone created by Wukong W Warrior Trickster, then hit Elise E Cocoon. Place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin, then transform with Elise R Spider Form and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite and basic attacks. Save Elise E Rappel to get out.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window after Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used is an opportunity to engage, but check whether Wukong E Nimbus Strike is still available. If both mobility abilities are down, close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and prevent his escape with Elise E Cocoon. If Wukong R Cyclone is also down, look for a fight or an objective while he has trouble engaging or disengaging.
MonkeyKing.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades. Avoid extended duels with Wukong and convert advantages from short trades into objectives and towers. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so catch targets with Elise E Cocoon instead of trying to hold the frontline.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: As Elise, stay behind in Human Form and look for an angle to hit Elise E Cocoon. After your allies engage, close in on a target whose health has dropped with R Spider Form. Fight where there’s a unit to land on with Elise E Rappel, keeping a route to retreat.

Nunu.build: Hold out early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Nunu & Willump’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume is a problem, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Nunu.fight: Fight after dodging Nunu & Willump’s snowball engage or catching them with Elise E Cocoon. While health is still high, use Elise Q Neurotoxin first, then close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite after dealing damage and finish them. Nunu & Willump can heal with Nunu & Willump Q Consume, so don’t get careless just because you came out ahead in a trade.
Nunu.laning: After one gank, another may follow via the Rift Scuttler. Once Elise learns Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes pulled toward your allies where the enemy has stepped forward.
Nunu.combo: Find an angle from the side and hit Elise E Cocoon so minions or jungle monsters don’t intercept it. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at the enemy’s feet, hit with Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Leap in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and use basic attacks; if the spiderlings are attached, use Elise W Skittering Frenzy.
Nunu.escape: Engage after Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! has passed or when you’ve caught them with Elise E Cocoon. Nunu & Willump have no ability to create distance on their own, so close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and deal your damage. If you plan to escape, save Elise E Rappel. Before escaping over a wall, check that there’s a unit to land on.
Nunu.phase: Elise is strong from then through the mid game, so convert your advantages into objectives and towers. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so push the game forward early instead of farming for a long time and waiting.
Nunu.teamfight: As Elise, look for an angle to hit Elise E Cocoon from behind in Human Form, and watch for a chance to interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero’s channel. If your allies engage first or a key enemy target’s health has dropped, close in with R Spider Form and finish them. If you can’t interrupt Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, leave its area. Fight where there’s a unit to land on with Elise E Rappel when retreating.
Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from far away and knocks you up. When you see it, don’t just run straight back; move toward the snowball and escape through the path Nunu & Willump took. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, leave the area immediately before the delayed root. Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero makes it harder to escape the longer you stay inside, so interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon or leave its range.

Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing in with Elise Q Venomous Bite is blocked, and you can’t use movement abilities for a short time. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one. If you’re hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before the second hit.
Poppy.fight: In Human Form, start by attacking Poppy while she still has plenty of health with Elise Q Neurotoxin. If Elise E Cocoon hits, follow up with Elise W Volatile Spiderling. Poppy gains more armor and magic resistance as her health gets low, so only chase her down if you have enough damage to finish her.
Poppy.laning: When facing Poppy, find an angle from the side where minions won’t block Elise E Cocoon. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador drops, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield.
Poppy.combo: After confirming Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, land Elise E Cocoon in Human Form first. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Poppy’s feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Close in on Poppy after her health has dropped with Elise Q Venomous Bite and keep using basic attacks. Save Elise E Rappel as a way to get out.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is an opportunity to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Elise Q Venomous Bite so the dash won’t be blocked. If Elise E Cocoon hits then, Poppy won’t be able to escape.
Poppy.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades. When fighting Poppy, use the window after Poppy E Heroic Charge and Poppy W Steadfast Presence are down. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so turn your early advantages into objectives and towers.
Poppy.build: Build armor first to prepare for Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.teamfight: Position at the back in human form to find an angle for Elise E Cocoon. After your allies engage, target someone whose health has decreased. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't jump in with Elise Q Venomous Bite; wait for it to end. When you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her frontal path. Fight near a unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel when you retreat.

Rammus.watch: When you see Rammus Q Powerball, keep minions between you and him and create distance in advance. Rammus R Soaring Slam has a larger area after he builds speed with Rammus Q Powerball, so dodge with plenty of room and don’t stay at the landing point. You can’t move or use abilities within range of Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, so keep your distance before he gets close.
Rammus.build: Get a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Rammus deals mostly magic damage, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rammus.combo: Hit Elise E Cocoon from an angle where minions won’t block it, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at the opponent’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow up by transforming with Elise R Spider Form and closing in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. If Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, don’t continue with basic attacks; unleash your damage after it ends.
Rammus.escape: If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is down and Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl has ended, catch him with Elise E Cocoon and close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Elise E Rappel is also needed to escape, so don’t go too deep while it’s on cooldown.
Rammus.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, so gain an advantage with early ganks. Look for opportunities when Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends and when Rammus R Soaring Slam is down. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so convert your early lead into objectives and turrets.
Rammus.teamfight: Stay behind in Human Form and look for an angle to catch a priority target with Elise E Cocoon. If you see Rammus rolling in with Rammus Q Powerball, anticipate the larger area of Rammus R Soaring Slam and back away; also move away from the landing point.
Rammus.fight: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, back off and wait for it to end. Attacking Rammus with basic attacks during this time deals reflected damage, so don’t use basic attacks with Elise W Skittering Frenzy on him either. Once W ends, start the fight with Elise Q Neurotoxin and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite when his health is low.
Rammus.laning: Once you've learned Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and the enemy has stepped forward. Put minions between you and Rammus Q Powerball's approach path, and cast Elise E Cocoon from the side at an angle where minions won't block it.

RekSai.watch: Watch for the knock-up when Rek’Sai surfaces with Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. When Rek’Sai Burrows, avoid narrow paths, and dodge the attack with Elise E Rappel as she surfaces. Right after you’re hit by Rek’Sai’s poke, stay close to allies because Rek’Sai R Void Rush may follow.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against Rek’Sai’s main damage. Armor doesn’t mitigate the true damage from Rek’Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek’Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of stacking health alone. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
RekSai.fight: Dodge the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, and fight when her mobility abilities and Rek’Sai R Void Rush are down. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first on Rek’Sai while she has high health, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health has dropped. If Rek’Sai Burrows to heal, keep attacking without giving her space.
RekSai.combo: Hit Rek’Sai with Elise E Cocoon from a side angle where minions won’t block it. Once you confirm the hit, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at her feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow up by transforming with Elise R Spider Form, diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and continuing with basic attacks.
RekSai.escape: The opportunity to engage comes after dodging the knock-up from Rek’Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow. If only Rek’Sai E Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek’Sai R Void Rush, so look for an opening especially before that R comes back up. Close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon.
RekSai.phase: Both champions can gain an advantage through ganks early, so avoid giving Rek’Sai a kill and look for opportunities after learning Elise E Cocoon. Convert the lead you build during Elise’s strong period through the mid game into objectives and turrets. As the game goes longer, Rek’Sai’s early and mid-game strengths fade, but Elise also contributes less to team fights, so use your early lead to finish the game sooner.
RekSai.laning: Early on, don't cross areas without vision alone. Choose lanes where the wave is pulled toward your team's side and Rek'Sai has stepped forward as gank targets. If you see the entrance to Rek'Sai E Tunnel near a lane or in your allied jungle, walk over it to destroy it. After learning Elise E Cocoon, look to gain an advantage through ganks and invades, but check Rek'Sai's position before invading.
RekSai.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in human form and use Elise E Cocoon to interrupt a key target. While Rek'Sai is airborne with Rek'Sai R Void Rush, don’t use targeted abilities; prepare Elise E Cocoon at her landing point. When your allies have engaged first or the enemy has already lost health, switch with Elise R Spider Form to close in and finish them. Fight where you can retreat with Elise E Rappel.

Sejuani.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots early. Sejuani’s main damage is magic, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath deals physical damage, so magic resistance won’t block it.
Sejuani.fight: Close the gap right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first on Sejuani while she has high health, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health has decreased. If you’re hit by the first strike of Sejuani W Winter’s Wrath, back off before the second strike.
Sejuani.laning: Find an angle from behind or beside the lane so minions don’t block Cocoon for your opponent. Look for early jungle control and objectives before Sejuani gets strong.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, hit her with Elise E Cocoon from an angle where minions won’t block it. After confirming the hit, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling to the opponent’s feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow up by transforming with Elise R Spider Form, diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and landing basic attacks.
Sejuani.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down. A target stunned once by Sejuani E Permafrost can’t gain stacks again for a short time, but the first basic attack immediately after the stun is applied deals bonus damage based on maximum health, so create distance as soon as the stun wears off. Elise E Rappel is also needed to escape, so don’t go too deep while it’s on cooldown.
Sejuani.phase: Elise is strong from when she learns Elise E Cocoon through the mid game, while Sejuani gains defenses over time and keeps locking down allies. Convert the gains from early ganks and jungle control into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so use your early and mid-game lead to finish the game sooner.
Sejuani.teamfight: As Elise, stay behind in Human Form and look for an angle to catch a priority target with Elise E Cocoon. Dive in with R Spider Form to finish when your allies have landed area-of-effect crowd control first or the opponent has already lost health. Watch for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison, and fight near an enemy unit you can descend onto to retreat with Elise E Rappel.
Sejuani.watch: When you see the windup for Sejuani Q Arctic Assault or Sejuani R Glacial Prison, move sideways to dodge. If Sejuani W Winter's Wrath's first hit lands, get out of range before its second hit, which deals heavy damage and applies a strong slow. Sejuani E Permafrost stacks can also build from the basic attacks of Sejuani's melee allies, so back away as the stacks rise.

Rengar.watch: Near brush, Rengar can use Rengar P Unseen Predator to engage and build resource at the same time, so avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight. Rengar E Bola Strike roots when his resource bar is full, so use Elise E Rappel after dodging it. Rengar W Battle Roar heals recent damage and, when empowered, also removes crowd control, so save Elise E Cocoon while his empowered W is available.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Rengar Q Savagery, Rengar E Bola Strike, and Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt. If you need to counter Rengar’s sudden engage, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to weather the counterattack right after you cast Elise E Cocoon. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon into your build after completing one core item.
Rengar.fight: Trade when Rengar’s resource bar is empty. Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down, catch him with Elise E Cocoon and focus your damage. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first on Rengar at full health, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite after his health has decreased.
Rengar.laning: Early on, clear the jungle in R Spider Form, using Elise P Spider Queen’s basic-attack healing and saving mana. After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your side where the enemy has stepped forward. Avoid paths beside brush when Rengar is out of sight, and use Control Wards to reveal brush.
Rengar.combo: Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, hit him with Elise E Cocoon from an angle where minions won’t block it. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Rengar’s feet, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite to sic your spiderlings on him, then finish with basic attacks.
Rengar.escape: If Rengar has jumped in and you’ve dodged Rengar E Bola Strike, engage while he has no ability to create distance. When Rengar W Battle Roar is down and his resource bar is empty, catch him with Elise E Cocoon, then deal damage with Elise Q Neurotoxin and Elise Q Venomous Bite. Avoid going deep with R Spider Form if Elise E Rappel isn’t ready.
Rengar.phase: Elise is strong from early game through mid game after learning Elise E Cocoon, so build an advantage with ganks and invades. Look for opportunities when Rengar’s resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so convert your early lead into objectives and turrets to finish the game sooner.
Rengar.teamfight: Wait in Human Form behind your frontline and within vision to reduce Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt’s angles for jumping onto your backline. After Rengar engages and uses Rengar W Battle Roar, catch him with Elise E Cocoon.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana W Inferno Aegis increases her movement speed so she can close in, and Shyvana Q Emberstrike deals heavy damage once she gets close. Keep your distance, then dodge the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent when she dives in and bind her with Elise E Cocoon after she lands.
Shyvana.build: Since most of Shyvana’s damage is magic, build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty, and don’t start an objective when it’s full. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin against Shyvana while she has high health, then finish her with Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health has decreased. Don’t use Cocoon while Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is in flight; use it after she lands.
Shyvana.laning: After clearing a few camps and learning Elise E Cocoon, gank lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your team first. Look for opportunities to take Shyvana’s jungle camps and objectives before she stacks Shyvana P Scalemail. Check Shyvana’s position before invading.
Shyvana.combo: From an angle where minions won’t block it, hit Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Shyvana’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow up by transforming with Elise R Spider Form, diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and attacking with basic attacks. If Shyvana used Shyvana R Dragon's Descent to dive in, confirm she has landed before leading with Cocoon.
Shyvana.escape: Engage after Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down or her Fury bar is empty. She is unstoppable while flying with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, so hit her with Elise E Cocoon after she lands. Only go deep when Elise E Rappel is available, and check that there’s a unit to descend onto when you retreat.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, Elise has a chance to put Shyvana behind with ganks and invades. Convert your lead by mid game into objectives and turrets. Shyvana grows stronger over time as Shyvana P Scalemail stacks permanently, so it’s best not to let the game drag on.
Shyvana.teamfight: Spread out so multiple teammates aren’t hit by Shyvana’s dragon-form AoE abilities. As Elise, look for an Elise E Cocoon angle from behind in human form, but don’t cast it during Shyvana R Dragon's Descent’s dash; hit her after she lands. Once your team engages and Shyvana’s health has decreased, switch to R Spider Form to close in and finish her. Fight where there’s a unit for Elise E Rappel to descend onto when you retreat.

Shaco.watch: If Shaco gets behind you with Shaco Q Deceive, his empowered first attack is dangerous, so face your team or keep your back to a wall if you think he’s nearby. Shaco W Jack In The Box in bushes without vision and around objectives causes fear, so check first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. When low on health, watch out for Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison and avoid paths without vision.
Shaco.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Shaco’s main damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Shaco Q Deceive, so get health as well. If Shaco counterattacks right after you throw Cocoon at his sudden engage, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Shaco.fight: Right after Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, he can’t immediately escape with the same ability, so bind him with Elise E Cocoon and focus him with your team. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first on the real Shaco while he has high health, then finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite after his health has decreased. Identify the clone from its health bar behavior when Shaco uses Shaco R Hallucinate, and back off when it dies to avoid the explosion and fear.
Shaco.laning: Early on, maintain vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco’s ganks and invades. After clearing a few camps and learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your team. Cocoon can be blocked by minions, so find an angle from the side or behind the lane.
Shaco.escape: Right after you force Shaco to use Shaco Q Deceive is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and block his escape route with Elise E Cocoon. Don’t go in first if you haven’t checked for Shaco W Jack In The Box in an area without vision.
Shaco.phase: Early on, both champions look for an advantage through ganks and invades, so find lanes where Elise E Cocoon can land without giving Shaco a kill. From learning Cocoon through mid game, Elise needs to turn her strength into ganks, objectives, and turrets. In the late game, Shaco’s ability to fight alone and Elise’s teamfight contribution both fall off, so use your early lead to close the game sooner.
Shaco.teamfight: In human form, look for a chance to catch a priority target from behind with Elise E Cocoon. When Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, focus the real one with your team. Switch to Elise R Spider Form to finish once your team has engaged or the target’s health has decreased. Don’t waste damage on the clone from Shaco R Hallucinate; back off when it dies to avoid the box and fear it leaves behind.
Shaco.combo: After Elise E Cocoon hits Shaco's real body as he appears with Shaco Q Deceive, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at his feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Then transform with Elise R Spider Form, close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and attack with basic attacks. Transform only after confirming Cocoon hits so you don't waste the crowd control.

Skarner.fight: Keep your distance and avoid walls while Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, then close in right after he uses it. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first against Skarner while he has high health, then finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite after his health has decreased. Don’t go deep if Elise E Rappel is down.
Skarner.laning: Focus on R Spider Form for your early jungle clear, but once you learn Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your side where the enemy has stepped forward. Find an angle from behind or the side of the lane so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. Take the initiative with ganks and objectives before Skarner gets tank items.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, hit Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at the enemy’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow up by transforming with Elise R Spider Form, diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and attacking with basic attacks. Use Elise W Skittering Frenzy after the spiderlings attach, and save Elise E Rappel so you can disengage.
Skarner.escape: Right after you force Skarner to use Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your window to engage. Apply pressure with Elise Q Neurotoxin, hit Elise E Cocoon, then switch to Elise R Spider Form and close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. If you let Skarner slam you into a wall with Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, he may be able to re-engage quickly, so be ready to retreat.
Skarner.phase: From early through mid game, ganks with Elise E Cocoon are strong, so focus on delaying Skarner’s item timings. Convert your lead into objectives and turrets. As Skarner gets tank items, his ability to lock down targets and his damage both increase, while Elise’s teamfight contribution falls off.
Skarner.teamfight: In human form, look for an Elise E Cocoon angle from behind, and keep your distance while accounting for Skarner R Impale’s short range and Skarner’s teammates. Fight where there’s a unit for Elise E Rappel to descend onto, and stay close to the edge of objective pits so you aren’t dragged away by Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance early against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. If you need to remove Skarner R Impale's suppression, decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.

Taliyah.watch: Taliyah Q Threaded Volley can’t change direction while being cast, so sidestep it. When Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, Taliyah W Seismic Shove may follow soon, so move away from the rocky ground. Check the ground first, since dashing across it with Elise Q Venomous Bite will stun you.
Taliyah.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Taliyah’s main damage is magic, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Taliyah.fight: Start a fight against Taliyah at full health with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish her with Elise Q Venomous Bite after her health has decreased. If Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is laid down, don’t dash in; go around the rocky ground to close in. If you keep damaging Taliyah, she can’t use Taliyah R Weaver's Wall, so keep attacking once you’re on her.
Taliyah.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your side where the enemy has stepped forward. Find an angle from behind or the side of the lane so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she can quickly affect another lane, so that lane should back off in advance.
Taliyah.combo: From an approach angle without rocky ground, hit Elise E Cocoon first. Confirm it hits, then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Taliyah’s feet and use Elise Q Neurotoxin before transforming with Elise R Spider Form. Follow up by diving in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and attacking with basic attacks, then use Elise W Skittering Frenzy once the spiderlings have attached.
Taliyah.escape: Engage after Taliyah W Seismic Shove and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth are down, from an angle that doesn’t cross rocky ground.
