If only one of Taliyah’s escape tools is down, she can still get away with the other, so especially look for an opening before Taliyah R Weaver's Wall comes back. Then close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch her with Elise E Cocoon.
Taliyah.phase: Elise is strong from learning Elise E Cocoon through mid game, and her early ganks are valuable. Convert the lead you gain into objectives and turrets to close the game sooner. In the late game, the proportion of Elise’s damage that is health-based and her teamfight contribution fall off.
Taliyah.teamfight: Before a fight, look for an Elise E Cocoon angle from behind in human form to catch a priority target such as Taliyah. Fight where there’s an enemy unit nearby for Elise E Rappel to descend onto when you retreat.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. However, Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, so armor alone cannot block all of it. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Udyr.fight: Harass Udyr with human-form Elise Q Neurotoxin before he gets close, and save Elise E Cocoon or E Rappel to respond to Udyr E Blazing Stampede. When Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, focus your damage so he has no chance to heal. Finish off Udyr after his health has decreased with R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite.
Udyr.laning: Elise looks for gank opportunities after clearing a few camps, once she has learned Elise E Cocoon. Prioritize lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your team and has stepped forward, and find an angle from the side where minions won’t block Cocoon. When you can’t see Udyr, check his movements with vision on key routes and jungle entrances before making a play.
Udyr.combo: Hit Udyr with Elise E Cocoon after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowerment ends. Then place human-form Elise W Volatile Spiderling under Udyr, cast Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Close in with R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite and basic attacks, then use Elise W Skittering Frenzy once your spiderlings have attached.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the distance. If the empowerment has ended, catch him with Elise E Cocoon, deal damage with human-form Elise Q Neurotoxin, then close in with R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite. Don’t dive deep if Elise E Rappel is unavailable and you can’t escape.
Udyr.phase: Elise is strong from the time she learns Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades. Convert that advantage into objectives and towers. Elise contributes less to team fights later, and Udyr becomes durable with defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, so avoid fights where you spend a long time hitting him first.
Udyr.teamfight: Find an angle from behind to hit Elise E Cocoon in human form, then close in with R Spider Form to finish off a target after your team engages or a key enemy’s health has decreased. Take out weaker enemies in the back line first instead of focusing damage on Udyr when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle. Fight where there are enemy units you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.
Udyr.watch: When Udyr runs at you with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch out for the stun on his first attack and save Elise E Rappel as an escape. Immobilizing effects don't work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so cast Elise E Cocoon after the Awakened effect ends. If you let him get close, you're more likely to take Udyr Q Wilding Claw's max-health damage and Udyr R Wingborne Storm's slow and area damage.

Vi.watch: When Vi charges Vi Q Vault Breaker, dodge by moving backward or to the side. Vi R Cease and Desist chases its target to the end, so don’t try to dodge it with Flash; use Elise E Cocoon after the landing and knock-up end. Vi W Denting Blows shreds armor with repeated hits, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight.
Vi.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vi Q Vault Breaker, W Denting Blows, and E Relentless Force. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier to prepare for Vi’s sudden engage and weather her counterattack right after you cast Elise E Cocoon.
Vi.fight: Close the distance right after Vi uses Vi Q Vault Breaker and catch her with Elise E Cocoon. If Vi P Blast Shield is active, wait for it to break before dealing damage, then keep the fight short and back away before Vi W Denting Blows stacks up.
Vi.laning: Early on, clear the jungle in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. After learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes where the enemy has stepped forward. When ganking, find an angle from behind or to the side so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. If Vi Q Vault Breaker is on cooldown, use that opening to engage.
Vi.combo: After you see Vi Q Vault Breaker go on cooldown, hit Elise E Cocoon, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling under her, and cast Elise Q Neurotoxin. Then transform with Elise R Spider Form, dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and follow up with basic attacks. Confirm that Elise E Cocoon hits before transforming so you don’t miss your chance to lock her down.
Vi.escape: The moment after you make Vi use Vi Q Vault Breaker or dodge it is your window to engage. Don’t waste Elise E Cocoon while Vi is charging in with Vi R Cease and Desist; use it after the landing and knock-up end. Before using Elise E Rappel to retreat, check that there’s an enemy unit you can land on.
Vi.phase: Elise is strong from the time she learns Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so create gank and fight opportunities while Vi Q Vault Breaker is on cooldown. Turn your early advantage into objectives and towers. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so focus on catching a target with Elise E Cocoon instead of fighting up front for a long time.
Vi.teamfight: Find an angle from behind to hit Elise E Cocoon in human form, then close in with R Spider Form on a target whose health has decreased after your team engages. If Vi R Cease and Desist is still available, keep your back-line damage dealers from wandering out of vision alone and stay within range of your team’s protective abilities. Fight where there’s a unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If the counterattack from his sudden engage is threatening, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. If a long duel makes the healing from Viego P Sovereign’s Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King a problem, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Viego.fight: Fight after interrupting Viego W Spectral Maw’s charge with Elise E Cocoon or dodging it to the side. Once Viego R Heartbreaker is also on cooldown, start by attacking a healthy Viego with Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite when his health is lower. Back away without giving up a kill in small fights you can’t win.
Viego.laning: After clearing a few early camps and learning Elise E Cocoon, prioritize lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your team and has stepped forward. Don’t push a lane toward the direction where Viego E Harrowed Path is visible; place a Control Ward or take another route around that area. When ganking, find an angle from the side or behind the lane so minions don’t intercept Elise E Cocoon.
Viego.combo: Dodge Viego W Spectral Maw or interrupt its charge with Elise E Cocoon, then confirm that Cocoon hits. Next, send Elise W Volatile Spiderling under him and hit him with Elise Q Neurotoxin before transforming with Elise R Spider Form. Dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and finish with basic attacks.
Viego.escape: Don’t engage just because Viego W Spectral Maw is on cooldown; check whether Viego R Heartbreaker is still available. In particular, close the distance with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch him with Elise E Cocoon when both Viego R Heartbreaker and Viego W Spectral Maw are on cooldown. If Elise E Rappel is unavailable, you have no way out, so don’t dive deep.
Viego.phase: Elise is strong from the time she learns Elise E Cocoon through mid game, so build an advantage with early ganks and invades. Convert that advantage into objectives and towers to end the game early. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so look for an angle to land Elise E Cocoon first.
Viego.teamfight: From behind in human form, catch Viego or a key target with Elise E Cocoon, then close in with R Spider Form on a target whose health has decreased after your team engages first. Don’t keep fighting where an ally was killed; lock Viego down or push him away from that spot so he can’t reach the wraith. If Viego possesses a body, create distance and use the moment he returns to his original body as a chance to counterattack.
Viego.watch: Viego W Spectral Maw stuns for longer the more it is charged, so dodge sideways when you see him charging and interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon. If you see Viego E Harrowed Path along terrain, watch for him to be camouflaged inside it and avoid the path. When your health is low, fall back because you can become a target for Viego R Heartbreaker.

XinZhao.watch: Move to the side to dodge the follow-up thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning. If Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike has hit you with two empowered basic attacks, use Elise E Rappel to get out of range before his third attack knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, don’t try to deal damage from outside his spear’s range.
XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao’s main damage. Xin Zhao P Determination provides healing, but consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item when the enemy team has a lot of healing.
XinZhao.fight: Start by attacking a healthy Xin Zhao with human-form Elise Q Neurotoxin, then finish him with R Spider Form Elise Q Venomous Bite when his health is lower. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, back away and wait out his damage immunity before fighting again.
XinZhao.laning: Early on, clear the jungle in R Spider Form to conserve health and mana. After learning Elise E Cocoon, gank lanes pushed toward your team first. Find an angle from the side so minions don’t intercept Cocoon, and dodge the thrust from Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning by moving to the side.
XinZhao.combo: After Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge has been used, hit him with human-form Elise E Cocoon. Then place Elise W Volatile Spiderling underfoot, cast Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form to finish him with Elise Q Venomous Bite and basic attacks.
XinZhao.escape: The moment after you make Xin Zhao use Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is your window to engage. Dodge Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike’s third attack, catch him with Elise E Cocoon, then close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite. Elise E Rappel may be needed to escape, so don’t dive deep while it’s unavailable.
XinZhao.phase: Elise is good at building an advantage through ganks from the early game, after she learns Elise E Cocoon, through mid game. Convert that advantage into objectives and towers. Elise contributes less to team fights later, so use the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends as a chance to counterattack.
XinZhao.teamfight: Find an angle from behind to hit Elise E Cocoon in human form, and keep your distance from allies so Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard’s knockback doesn’t split your formation. Fight where there’s an enemy unit you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Warwick.watch: While Warwick E Primal Howl is active, he takes reduced damage and then fears nearby enemies, so hold your burst and back away. Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses its target, and Warwick can leap from farther away than expected when his movement speed is increased, so don’t assume areas without vision are safe. When your health drops below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position, so don’t overstay.
Warwick.build: Warwick’s main damage is magic, and Elise has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, pick up Morellonomicon for healing reduction after completing one core item.
Warwick.fight: When Warwick E Primal Howl is active, don’t use all your skills at once; re-engage after the fear triggers. The window to engage is before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up. Land Elise E Cocoon, deal damage with human-form skills, then finish the target with R Spider Form. Even at low health, Warwick heals heavily, so don’t chase deep or dive just because his health is low.
Warwick.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, don’t just keep clearing camps; prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your side where the enemy has stepped forward. When ganking, find an angle from the side or behind the lane so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. If your health is below half, Warwick W Blood Hunt reveals your position, so give up some farm and recall.
Warwick.combo: From the side, land Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at the enemy’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with R Spider Form, close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and finish with basic attacks. If Warwick E Primal Howl is active, use this combo after the fear triggers.
Warwick.escape: Don’t engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is on cooldown; check whether Warwick R Infinite Duress is also available. In particular, go in before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back up and after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers. Close the gap with Elise Q Venomous Bite and catch him with Elise E Cocoon, but don’t go deep if you don’t have Elise E Rappel available to get out.
Warwick.phase: Elise is strong from then through the mid game, so convert your lead into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so use your early advantage to close out the game quickly.
Warwick.teamfight: In human form, find an angle from behind to land Elise E Cocoon. After your allies engage, finish off a target whose health has been reduced with R Spider Form. If Warwick R Infinite Duress catches an ally, decide whether to save them, and focus your counterattack while Warwick is locked in place. When contesting objectives, watch for Warwick’s long-range leap and fight where there are units you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge-up and knocks enemies airborne after he lands, so interrupt him with Elise E Cocoon if you see him charging from behind a wall. Watch out for the slow and knock-up from Zac Q Stretching Strikes. After dealing with his engage, create distance to avoid the max-health-based damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Walk over the chunks Zac drops to prevent him from healing and reducing his W cooldown.
Zac.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zac’s main damage is magic, and Elise has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, fit Morellonomicon in after completing one core item.
Zac.fight: Close the gap and fight right after Zac E Elastic Slingshot goes on cooldown. Against a high-health Zac, use Elise Q Neurotoxin first, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite once his health is lower. Catch Zac with Elise E Cocoon or walk over his chunks yourself to stop him from collecting them.
Zac.laning: In the jungle, build up spiderlings with human-form skills, then transform and focus on clearing with R Spider Form. After learning Elise E Cocoon, don’t spend too long on camps; prioritize ganking lanes pulled toward your side where the enemy has stepped forward. Cocoon is blocked by minions and jungle monsters, so secure a path from the side or behind the lane before casting it.
Zac.combo: If Zac E Elastic Slingshot is on cooldown or you interrupted its charge with Elise E Cocoon, confirm Cocoon hits, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Zac’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with R Spider Form, dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and land basic attacks.
Zac.escape: The moment after you make Zac use E Elastic Slingshot is your chance to engage, so close the gap with Elise Q Neurotoxin or Q Venomous Bite and use Elise E Cocoon to stop him from escaping. You may need Elise E Rappel to disengage, so don’t force an engage while it’s on cooldown.
Zac.phase: Elise is strong from after learning E Cocoon through the mid game, so build an early lead with ganks and invades. Before fighting Zac or contesting an objective, check whether Zac P Cell Division’s revive is available. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so convert your early lead into objectives and turrets to close out the game quickly.
Zac.teamfight: Before a fight, stay behind in human form and find an angle to land Elise E Cocoon. If you see Zac E Elastic Slingshot charging, interrupt it with Cocoon. After dealing with Zac’s engage, create distance to avoid the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, then finish off a target whose health has been reduced with R Spider Form after your allies engage. Fight where there are enemy units you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Belveth.watch: Bel’Veth W Above and Below knocks enemies airborne and resets Bel’Veth Q Void Surge’s cooldown, so if Bel’Veth closes in, dodge by turning to the side instead of running straight back. Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom greatly reduces the damage she takes, so don’t use all of Elise’s skills at once; wait for it to end or interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon.
Belveth.build: Build armor first to counter Bel’Veth Q Void Surge and Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, add Morellonomicon for healing reduction after completing one core item.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below, and fight from an angle where you can catch her with Elise E Cocoon before Bel’Veth Q Void Surge comes back up. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first against a high-health Bel’Veth, then unload your damage after Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom ends and finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite.
Belveth.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, look for early ganks on lanes where the enemy has pushed forward. Before Bel’Veth builds stacks, take camps and large monsters with jungle invades and early skirmishes, but check Bel’Veth’s position before invading.
Belveth.combo: In human form, land Elise E Cocoon, place Elise W Volatile Spiderling at Bel’Veth’s feet, then use Elise Q Neurotoxin. Follow with R Spider Form to summon spiderlings, dive in with Elise Q Venomous Bite, and continue with basic attacks. If Bel’Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, wait for it to end or interrupt it with Elise E Cocoon before unloading your damage.
Belveth.escape: Dodge Bel’Veth W Above and Below; the moment after Bel’Veth Q Void Surge goes on cooldown is your chance to engage. Bel’Veth can’t immediately use Q Void Surge again in the direction she just dashed, so land Elise E Cocoon during that window and attack before she can escape.
Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth is weak early without stacks, and Elise has high gank value, so start building a lead with ganks and invades after learning Elise E Cocoon. Convert the lead you build through mid game into objectives and turrets. Bel’Veth’s permanent stacks build up late while Elise contributes less to teamfights, so you fall behind as the game goes on.
Belveth.teamfight: In human form, stay behind and find an angle to land Elise E Cocoon. Close in with R Spider Form to finish the target after your allies engage or once Bel’Veth’s health has decreased. If an ally dies and leaves a Void Coral, back away before Bel’Veth collects it, and delay the teamfight while Bel’Veth is transformed by R Endless Banquet. Fight where there are units you can land on with Elise E Rappel to retreat.

Nocturne.watch: Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one skill and doubles Nocturne’s attack speed if it blocks one, so don’t immediately cast Elise E Cocoon. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror connects, create distance to break the tether. If you’re hit by Nocturne Q Duskbringer, don’t flee in a straight line along its trail. When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, move toward your allies immediately.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first to counter the physical damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia. If you’re concerned about counterattacks after diving in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and use it right after casting Elise E Cocoon. If the enemy team has a lot of healing, consider Morellonomicon after completing one core item.
Nocturne.fight: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, use another skill to break it first, then look for a chance to land Elise E Cocoon. Use Elise Q Neurotoxin first against a high-health Nocturne, then finish with Elise Q Venomous Bite once his health is lower.
Nocturne.laning: After learning Elise E Cocoon, gank lanes where the enemy is pushed toward your allies first. Find an angle from behind the lane or from the side so minions don’t block Elise E Cocoon. Maintain vision in the river and jungle entrances, and plan where to retreat before Nocturne R Paranoia is activated.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, confirm that Elise W Volatile Spiderling has broken the shield first. Then land Elise E Cocoon, use Elise Q Neurotoxin, and transform with Elise R Spider Form. Close in with Elise Q Venomous Bite and land basic attacks. Save Elise E Rappel to dodge a counterattack or escape.
Nocturne.phase: Convert the lead from early ganks into objectives and turrets. Elise contributes less to teamfights late, so catch a target with Cocoon instead of fighting head-on for too long.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, stay close to your allies instead of getting isolated. Before a fight, stay behind in human form and find an angle to land Elise E Cocoon after Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is no longer active.
